method: Horizontal triangle sections, fixed model datum, outward support line then TLS; no ICP, scale or circle fit for the chamfer.

source.modifier_status: TurboSmooth unapplied on caps. C7 CROSS-CHECK accepts the straight PLAN dimensions; radii are estimates.

joint_angle.method: Directions of the two long block-joint section edges at Z=800, four corners; acute angle to the transverse axis.

junction_round.method: R = median complete bevel-loop chord / (2 sin(turn/2)). EST circular finish envelope from apron loops, transferred to cap junctions. Not decoded TurboSmooth, not a measured smooth radius.
junction_round.caveat: The cap junctions themselves are sharp in the cage. This small round is TESSELLATION/EST, not MODEL.
